image_evidence.scope: Actual software-Vulkan first-case pixels/depth. Identical per-layer crop and nearest-neighbour enlargement for texel inspection. Difference image is multiplied by 32. Primary source and receivers identical.

plant_render.scope: Actual native full/reduced six-form plants and a ground receiver; software Vulkan only. Two-sided raster sample comparison with at most two connected unmatched texels, <0.1% unmatched and <1% changed coverage; final colour including the ground receiver max<=16/255 and mean<=0.1/255 in this fixture. Full oracle exact, primary unchanged, invalid update and cache checks. No target-GPU timing or general radiometric acceptance.

limitations: Physical Radeon replay remains blocked; no display/device access and no dense raster or AS submission in the native probe.

Cached scalar LOD error may retain slightly more full geometry; compare submitted triangles directly rather than claiming an unchanged count.

API batches are distinct from logical commands and driver-native calls.
Source memory, atlas/command GPU reservations, bounds/scratch CPU storage and driver in-flight memory are distinct.
